data.headline: Head of Engineering - Software Engineering in Generative AI on Amazon Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI , ML, DevOps, Infra-Cloud Solution Architect, SRE, FinOps & Operations Engineering
data.about: Experienced Technical Director with a demonstrated history of working in the computer software industry. Skilled in  AL, ML, DevOps, Cloud Implementations/Solutioning, SRE, Middleware Administration engineer and Operations Engineering with over 17+years of experience in IT industry in Infrastructure, Automation, Configuration management, Application management, Logging and Monitoring, Continuous Integration, Continuous Deployment, Orchestration and Team Management.

description.text:
